title: Transition-metal coordination modulates predicted DNA groove recognition and nucleobase contacts in oligohistidine complexes.
authors: Agar, Soykan; Yildiz, Alparslan Numan; Yurtsever, Mine
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接和MD模拟比较金属配位寡组氨酸与B-DNA的沟槽识别和碱基接触，属广义蛋白-DNA互作建模，方法可迁移至TF-DNA研究，但对象非TF体系。
abstract: Histidine-rich peptides are widely used in affinity-based purification because imidazole donors can coordinate transition-metal ions. To examine how fixed metal-coordination models may alter the predicted DNA-contacting behavior of a histidine hexamer, a fully in silico comparison was performed using metal-free His(6) and the tri-metal model complexes [Zn(3)(His(6))](6+), [Ni(3)(His(6))](6+), and [Cu(3)(His(6))](6+) against the canonical B-DNA dodecamer 1BNA [d(CGCGAATTCGCG)]. The formulas denote the neutral-terminal/neutral-imidazole computational representation used for docking and molecular dynamics (MD), rather than a claim concerning the dominant solution-phase species. Molecular docking and MD simulations were used to compare predicted groove localization, recurrent nucleobase-associated contacts, hydrogen-bond patterns, relative docking scores, and trajectory-based structural persistence. Within the examined 1BNA model, metal-free His(6) produced a dominant major-groove pose with adenine-associated contacts and a Vina docking score of -8.9 kcal/mol. The tri-metal coordination models produced dominant minor-groove poses with guanine-associated contacts, with relative docking scores of -9.5, -13.5, and -10.8 kcal/mol for the Zn(II), Ni(II), and Cu(II) models, respectively. The Ni(II)- and Cu(II)-containing models also displayed lower RMSD levels than the metal-free complex over the sampled trajectories. These observations are restricted to the defined computational models and the 1BNA sequence; they do not establish experimental binding affinities, universal nucleobase selectivity, or solution-phase metal speciation. The work provides a hypothesis-generating comparison that may guide future experimental investigation of metal-coordinated oligohistidine-DNA interactions.
abstract_zh: 富含组氨酸的肽因其咪唑供体能够配位过渡金属离子，被广泛用于基于亲和力的纯化。为了考察固定的金属配位模型可能如何改变组氨酸六聚体预测的DNA结合行为，本研究采用无金属His(6)及三金属模型复合物[Zn(3)(His(6))](6+)、[Ni(3)(His(6))](6+)和[Cu(3)(His(6))](6+)，针对经典B-DNA十二聚体1BNA [d(CGCGAATTCGCG)]进行了全计算比较。这些化学式表示用于对接和分子动力学（MD）的中性末端/中性咪唑计算表示，而非对溶液相主要物种的断言。通过分子对接和MD模拟，比较了预测的沟槽定位、重复出现的核碱基相关接触、氢键模式、相对对接分数以及基于轨迹的结构持久性。在所考察的1BNA模型中，无金属His(6)产生了以腺嘌呤相关接触为主的优势大沟姿态，Vina对接分数为-8.9 kcal/mol。三金属配位模型则产生了以鸟嘌呤相关接触为主的优势小沟姿态，Zn(II)、Ni(II)和Cu(II)模型的相对对接分数分别为-9.5、-13.5和-10.8 kcal/mol。含Ni(II)和Cu(II)的模型在采样轨迹中还显示出比无金属复合物更低的RMSD水平。这些观察仅限于所定义的计算模型和1BNA序列；它们并不确立实验结合亲和力、普遍核碱基选择性或溶液相金属形态。本研究提供了一种生成假设的比较，可能指导未来对金属配位寡组氨酸-DNA相互作用的实验研究。
